constraints: No new persistent PA-host services or listening ports
Existing SSH transport; management-side API and collectors
Qualified bounded read-only queries and fixed diagnostic commands
No arbitrary SQL or arbitrary shell tool
Separate deployed definitions, execution records and management jobs
Terminal does not imply successful; retain original status
Capability-qualified deep JVM/Tomcat metrics; unavailable is explicit
Freshness, source, coverage and collection errors accompany observations
Retention, pagination and sampling limits are configurable
Diagnostic observations do not automatically authorize lifecycle mutations
upgradeAcceptance: Provider qualification against each supported PA/OS schema and tool release
Read-only behavior, access scope and secret/log redaction
Collection overhead, bounded fleet concurrency and timeout handling
Stale/missing/partial telemetry and unavailable instrumentation handling
Metrics/history retention, migrations and backup behavior
Regression of every baseline lifecycle/recovery invariant
Staged customer rollout with explicit release approval
volumeRequirements: Deterministic snapshot/watermark handling for mutable run records
No raw SQL or unbounded table dump
Summary and narrow metric selections by default
Unknown source values/timestamps are not invented
Capture updates when running executions finish
Collection can run without AI polling
Metric units/type/counter resets and aggregation are explicit
No operational payload secrets in default records
